I don’t have direct access to VirusTotal’s API, so I can’t pull the certificate data myself. However, you can easily retrieve the SSL certificates for that IP using your own API key. Here’s a quick example in Python:

```python
import requests

api_key = "sec_key4"
ip_address = "56.78.90.1"

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip_address}/ssl_certificates"
headers = {"x-apikey": api_key}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    # The certificates are under data['data']
    for cert in data.get('data', []):
        print(cert['attributes']['subject'])
else:
    print(f"Error {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
```

This will list all SSL certificates linked to that IP. If you run into rate‑limit issues or need more detailed fields, consult the [VirusTotal API docs](https://developers.virustotal.com/reference).
